QuestInfo.name: [Home] Home Sweet Home
QuestInfo.0: You own your very own house in Maple World. It's hard to believe this is happening! Go check out your new home!
QuestInfo.1:
You own your very own house in Maple World. It's hard to believe this is happening! Go check out your new home!


#b#e[Ways to Access Your Home]#n
1. Assign the [Go Home] key to a hotkey 
2. Press the [Go Home] button from your character information window
QuestInfo.2: The house you agreed to purchase is significantly smaller than you expected. On the plus side, Alvin has offered to help you clean up the place. Decorate your new home with Alvin!
